3.0.1

2026-07-08
Fixed
  • Fixed the keypose editor's on-screen controls freezing after switching to another keypose

3.0.0

2026-07-07
Warning
Requires Final Cut Pro 12.3 and Motion 6.3 or later. Earlier versions are not supported.
New
  • Moved to the new Keyframeless timing engine - animate position, scale, rotation, anchor, and opacity with keyposes
  • New on-screen rotation controls: a dynamic triple-ring control in the viewer and a rotation control in the mini-canvas
  • AI integration
  • Presets
  • Interactive guides
Changelog begins at 3.0.0. Earlier releases are on GitHub.
MagicMove is a Final Cut Pro FxPlug effect, part of the Keyframeless suite.
